minutes.headline: Planning Board approved the Brazilian restaurant site plan at 5 Summer Street and continued the 383 Whalum Road hearing to April 10.
minutes.summary: The board endorsed sureties for two Watt Street lots, heard the director's report including research on the recall process, approved prior minutes, and took committee reports. Two public hearings followed: the Summer Street restaurant site plan was approved, and the Whalum Road auto sales site plan was continued so the plan can be amended and the DPW director consulted.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the site plan for a restaurant at 5 Summer Street by voice vote, after closing the public hearing.
The board continued the 383 Whalum Road auto sales hearing to April 10 at 6:05 PM so the applicant can submit a revised plan.
The board endorsed the surety for 19 and 21 Watt Street by voice vote.
The director reported on research into the recall process; the planner will give the town clerk and town manager notice about its requirements.

why_it_matters: The Summer Street approval lets the restaurant project move toward permitting, and the Whalum Road delay holds up an auto sales license, which the select board is waiting on this board's action to decide.
The Watt Street surety is money posted to guarantee the lots are stabilized, which protects the town from carrying that site work if a project stalls.

The planner's draft approval for 5 Summer Street, due for signature at the next meeting.
